Luxury Condo with Stunning Views in Cathedral Hill
Experience modern elegance in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo featuring an open-concept layout, high-end finishes, and a private balcony with breathtaking west-facing views of the Cathedral of Saint Mary and stunning sunsets. The spa-like primary suite includes a soaking tub, separate shower, and in-unit laundry for ultimate convenience.
Located in the prestigious Post International, residents enjoy premium amenities: a gym, yoga studio/playroom, courtyard, conference room, and 24-hour concierge and security. Deeded parking is also included.
With a Walk Score of 99, this prime Cathedral Hill location offers unparalleled access to Japantown, Pacific Heights, the Fillmore District, Hayes Valley, Alamo Square, and Lafayette Park with its playground. Stroll to vibrant dining, boutique shopping, and cultural landmarks, or simply enjoy the serene courtyard and luxurious amenities.
Perfect for those seeking luxury, convenience, and breathtaking views, this urban sanctuary offers a lifestyle like no other. Don't miss this opportunity - schedule your showing today!
